bio.text: Dan Daley represents District 96 in the Florida House of Representatives. According to the House, Daley was elected on June 18, 2019, and reelected subsequently.
Daley served as a Coral Springs city commissioner from 2012 to 2019, including as vice mayor from 2015 to 2017.

The House lists Daley's residence as Coral Springs and an occupation of prosecutor. Daley holds a B.S. from Florida State University (2010) and a J.D. from Nova Southeastern University, and was born in Huntington, New York.
